description: Official Swiss retirement-provision figures for the current year and, once decided, the next year: pillar 3a maximum deduction (with / without pension fund), AHV/IV old-age pension minimum and maximum per month and the married couple cap, BVG entry threshold and coordination deduction, minimum AHV contributions, supplementary-benefit amounts, withdrawal rules and retroactive 3a buy-ins. Each figure with its official source (Federal Council, BSV, ESTV).
name: pension_figures
